Who We Are

More Than a Money Transfer Agent

SYLREG & KIDS INVESTMENT LIMITED is a Sierra Leone-based multi-service company founded in November 2025, strategically located at 9 Symthe Street, Congo Market — directly Congo Market, Freetown.

We were established to bridge the gap between international financial services and everyday Sierra Leoneans. Whether you're sending money to a loved one abroad, exchanging currency, seeking business consulting, or shopping wholesale and retail — we are your one roof for it all.

Authorized agents for eight (8) of the world's most trusted remittance and payment networks including Western Union, MoneyGram, Ria, Afro International, NAFA, BnB, Cash Moov, and EDSA — we have built a reputation for speed, security, and genuine service.

Our Direction

Mission & Vision

🎯

Our Mission

To deliver fast, secure, and affordable finance, trade and business services to individuals and enterprises in Sierra Leone — connecting them to global opportunities while serving their everyday local needs with integrity.

🔭

Our Vision

To become Sierra Leone's most trusted multi-service investment company — the first name people think of for money transfer, procurement, logistics, printing, commerce, trade and marketing solutions.

Our Journey

How We Started

SYLREG & KIDS INVESTMENT LIMITED was born out of a clear need in Freetown — a single trustworthy place where Sierra Leoneans could handle their financial and business needs without bouncing between multiple offices. From day one, we committed to offering a full-service experience under one roof.

November 14, 2025

Grand Opening

SYLREG & KIDS INVESTMENT LIMITED officially opens its doors at 9 Symthe Street, Congo Market — Congo Market, Freetown.

December 2025

Full Partner Network Live

Western Union money transfer operations fully activated. Procurement & logistics, general supplies, photocopy & printing services launched and fully operational.

Early 2026

Consulting & Retail Expansion

Commerce & trade division and marketing services unit officially launched, providing a complete one-stop business & investment experience to all clients.

2026 & Beyond

Growing Stronger

Expanding reach across Sierra Leone, deepening trade partnerships, and exploring digital platforms to serve Sierra Leoneans nationwide and in the diaspora.
